questions.question: Design a screwjack to lift a load of 3700 kg through a maximum lift of 250 mm. The screw is made of steel having an yield strength of 300 MPa, in tension & compression. The nut is made of phosphor bronze having an allowable bearing pressure of 15 MPa. The cup and body are made of cast iron having an ultimate strength of 500 MPa in compression & 250 MPa in tension. Draw the sectional front view and top view of screwjack assembly . OR Design an automobile single plate clutch to transmit 28 kW at 2000 rpm. There are 3 toggle levers, actuating arm & clutch pedal for releasing the clutch. Cross section of lever is t x 3t, where t is thickness. There are 6 springs to engage the clutch. Allowable shear stress for spring material is 360 MPa. Mechanical advantage required is 20. Maximum foot pressure on the pedal is 350 N. Draw sectional front view of clutch assembly. Also draw the side view showing the position of springs, toggle levers and actuating arm. Justify the friction theory used for deciding the mean diameter of the clutch plate. (35) (MEE-307) Page 1 of 1

questions.question: Design a screw jack used to lift a load of 3700 kg through a height of 200 mm. Failure of screw jack is considered as failure of handle. The screw rod is made of steel having an yield strength of 300 MPa, in tension & compression. The nut is made of phosphor bronze having an allowable bearing pressure of 15 MPa. The cup and body are made of cast iron having an ultimate strength of 500 MPa in compression & 250 MPa in tension. Draw the sectional front view of screw jack such that position of screw corresponds to a lift of 10^0 mm. Also prepare part drawing of cup. OR Design the valve gear mechanism for the exhaust valve of an IC engine having the following specifications. (MEE 307) 1 Valve diameter = 75 mm, Lift of the valve = 25 mm, Weight of the valve = 4 N. Valve opens 33o before outer dead centre position and closes 1o after inner dead center position. Valve opens and closes with constant acceleration and deceleration for each half of the cycle. Engine speed = 275 rpm. The peak pressure when the exhaust valve opens is 0.4 N/mm2 . Stiffness of the spring used is 9 N/mm and spring index is 8. Rocker arm has an I section and is made of cast steel having an ultimate strength of 400 MPa. Draw the sectional front view and top view of roller pin assembly. (35) (MEE 307) 2
